name: 45373 · Troy, OH
findings: ZIP 45373 (Troy) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45373 (Troy) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45373 (Troy) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
